Commentary.Commentary: The rain has stopped and the covers are off. We are all set to get underway! Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma walk out to the middle. Ayabonga Khaka to begin.
Well, the chase should have began by now but sadly, the covers are on and it is raining. Let's hope it is just a passing shower and we get some action quickly.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

The middle order failed big time and the likes of Arundhati Reddy and Deepti Sharma were excellent. At one time, 200 looked far away but Meike De Ridder along with Tumi Sekhukhune played well to help them get over that mark. They'll have to bowl really well to defend this. India on the other hand, will back themselves to chase this down. Join us for the chase in a bit.

That innings from Meike De Ridder has helped South Africa to get over the 200-run mark but we believe that is well below par. India will be extremely pleased with how the way they bowled. Especially after the start the visitors got off to. Laura Wolvaardt and Tazmin Brits added 102 with Laura strong a half ton. But once she fell, they kept losing wickets at regular intervals.
A single to end but a superb last over for South Africa. Full and on middle. This jammed out to mid off for one.
